# Paw & Prosper

> SEO and AI visibility specialists for animal wellness businesses. We help veterinarians, pet brands, animal shelters, and animal rescues get found on Google and recommended by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Founded by Samantha Quinones, a digital marketing strategist specializing in SEO and AI visibility systems for the animal wellness industry.

## Services

- [SEO & AI Visibility Services](https://pawandprosper.com/services): Overview of all service offerings including local SEO, LLM optimization, content strategy, and AI chatbot implementation.
- [Veterinary Clinic SEO](https://pawandprosper.com/seo-for-veterinary-clinics): Specialized SEO and AI visibility for independent veterinary practices competing with corporate chains.
- [Animal Shelter SEO](https://pawandprosper.com/seo-for-animal-shelters): Visibility strategies to help shelters attract more adopters, donors, and volunteers through search and AI.
- [Animal Rescue SEO](https://pawandprosper.com/seo-for-animal-rescues): SEO and AI optimization for rescue organizations to increase adoptions and community support.
- [Pet Brand SEO](https://pawandprosper.com/seo-for-pet-brands): E-commerce SEO and AI visibility for pet product brands wanting to reduce reliance on paid ads.

## Company

- [About Paw & Prosper](https://pawandprosper.com/about): Founder story, mission, and approach to animal wellness marketing.
- [Free Visibility Audit](https://pawandprosper.com/free-audit): Free SEO and AI visibility audit for pet businesses — no obligation.
